about.title: About me
about.lead: My name is Grégoire Fortuné and I study computer science at IUT d’Aubière (63).
about.description: Here are some signposts to better understand who I am and what drives my progress in development.

paragraphs: I am currently in my 2nd year of the B.U.T Informatique program. This is where I strengthen my skills in algorithms, web/mobile development and application design.
The curriculum mixes core CS (programming, databases, networks) with transversal skills like communication, project management or law, which gives me a comprehensive view of the profession.
I am looking for a 10-week internship starting April 2026 to put these skills into practice within a professional team and continue learning on the job.

about.photoAlt: Photo of Grégoire Fortuné with a flowery background

more.title: A bit more about me
paragraphs: I am an ambitious person who always seeks to take on more demanding challenges. My curiosity drives me to explore new topics and learn new skills whenever the opportunity arises.
I currently live in Auvergne for my studies, although my origins are elsewhere. This change taught me adaptability and openness to new environments.
Sport plays an important role: volleyball, handball or climbing teach me mutual support, discipline and pushing limits. These values follow me in my student life and in the projects I undertake.

items.title: CineRentPro
items.summary: Creation of a showcase site for a fictional company renting and refurbishing multimedia equipment.

segments.title: Context
segments.text: As part of SAE 1.06, we had to present CineRent Pro, a fictional company that rents and refurbishes multimedia equipment in Europe.

segments.title: Objectives
items: Apply HTML/CSS basics to structure a multi-section site.
Organize content: presentation, SWOT analysis, economic and environmental data.
Set up clear navigation with internal anchors and responsive design.
Highlight teamwork by distributing roles (copy, design, integration).

segments.title: Work done
items: Wrote content: presentation, SWOT, economic and ecological indicators.
HTML structure divided into sections: Introduction, Attributes, Environment and Economy.
CSS layout, Font Awesome icons and responsive adjustments.
Inserted images (logo, data centers, refurbishment process).
Fixed navigation bar with anchor links.
Coordinated the team to synchronize code, design and communication.

segments.title: Result
segments.text: The final showcase site professionally reflects the company identity. We scored 12/20 (average 10.8/20 – top grade 14.5/20) by emphasizing our web and strategic skills.

items.title: Gen3DMap (this project is still at idea stage)
items.summary: Development of an AI capable of automatically generating playable and customizable 3D maps.

segments.title: Context
segments.text: Authoring 3D maps manually is time-consuming and expensive. The idea is to automate it without sacrificing variety, gameplay, or visual coherence.

segments.title: Objective
segments.text: Design an AI/procedural system that produces parameterized terrains and exports them to Unity or Unreal.

items.title: Research & analysis
details: Studying Perlin noise, Voronoï, 3D GANs, L-systems, etc.
Reviewing famous procedural engines (Minecraft, No Man’s Sky, …).

items.title: Data preparation
details: Annotating key areas: POIs, playable zones, resources.

items.title: AI modeling
details: Experimenting with 3D GANs or enhanced procedural generation.
Adding control parameters: density, biomes, topography.

items.title: Visualization & integration
details: Exporting meshes or heightmaps for Unity.
Realtime display with a navigation camera.
Simple UI to tweak and test parameters.
